notes: Figure types: the upright figure in each subsidiary cell = all Kannada speakers using that subsidiary language (persons with several subsidiaries counted under each), so the upright Total (cols 4-5) = sum of the upright language columns; the italic figure = persons speaking that language as their only subsidiary, and cols 20-27 (italic only) = persons with 2/3/4/5 subsidiary languages; italic Total = sum of italic language cols + cols 20-27. Both identities hold on every row after reading. Italic in the C&M Station row is set bold like the rest of that row. Print inconsistency kept as printed: State incl. C&M Station, Mother-tongue Females printed 2,562,204, but excl. (2,252,355) + C&M (3,849) = 2,256,204, which is the Part I Kannada figure (leaf 214); the Part II print transposes digits. All other mother-tongue figures match Part I. In this scan the upright figure 4 often looks like a 1; these cells were read as 4 on zoom and confirmed by the row/column totals: Bangalore District Hindustani M 2,240, Tamil F 642, Total F 30,247; Kolar District Total M 64,104; Tumkur Marathi M 134; Mysore City Telugu M 469, Total F 642; Mysore District Tamil M 841; Hassan Telugu F 342. Kadur District col 20 (Two subsidiary languages, M, italic) has an ink blot over the first digit; the visible '21' plus the italic Total (2,953) require 121, which is recorded. Mother tongue Kannada; subsidiary-language spellings match Part I.
